delete.description:
Clears all tenant Custom Hostname Mappings.

**Required Permissions:** `custom-hostname-mappings:delete`

204.description: The Custom Hostname Mappings were cleared. No content is returned.

get.description:
Returns the tenant Custom Hostname Mappings as a MappingList object (standard collection envelope). The full bounded set is returned in a single response and `totalCount` reflects the complete set. Pagination is currently not supported.

**Required Permissions:** `custom-hostname-mappings:read`

put.description:
Replaces the entire set of tenant Custom Hostname Mappings with the supplied JSON list. The previous mappings are fully overwritten.

**Required Permissions:** `custom-hostname-mappings:update`

schema.description: The full set of custom hostname mappings to set — whole-list replace, at most 500 entries. The previous mappings are fully overwritten.

204.description: The Custom Hostname Mappings were replaced. No content is returned.

errors.description: A record value is not a valid IPv4 address.
At most 500 custom hostname mappings may be configured.

400.description: Bad Request. The request body failed validation — a malformed field such as an invalid hostname or IP address (`INVALID_FIELD`), or the list exceeds the 500-entry maximum (`LIST_SIZE_EXCEEDED`).

errors.description: The tenant is not entitled to ZTNA routing for this mapping.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. **Reserved — not enforced in the current release:** the DNS public API is gated solely by its feature flag, with no per-record SKU entitlement check. `NOT_ENTITLED` is documented for forward-compatibility only; once SKU enforcement lands (out of scope for the current release) it would be returned per record when a mapping requests a capability the tenant is not licensed for, such as Secure DNS or ZTNA routing.

delete.description:
Clears the tenant Search Domain, removing the configured suffix.

**Required Permissions:** `search-domains:delete`

204.description: The Search Domain was cleared. No content is returned.

get.description:
Returns the tenant Search Domain — a singleton resource holding a single optional search-domain suffix. Returns 200 with the search domain when one is set, or 404 when none is set.

**Required Permissions:** `search-domains:read`

put.description:
Sets the tenant Search Domain to the supplied suffix. Any previously set search domain is overwritten.

**Required Permissions:** `search-domains:update`

204.description: The Search Domain was set. No content is returned.

400.description: Bad Request. The request body failed validation — for example, a malformed search-domain suffix (`INVALID_FIELD`).

get.description:
Returns the full list of DNS Zones configured for the tenant. The list is not paginated and is bounded by a per-customer maximum zone cap. The full bounded set is returned in a single response and `totalCount` reflects the complete set. Pagination is currently not supported.

**Required Permissions:** `ztna:read`

parameters.description: Sort expression in the form `field:direction`, where direction is `asc` or `desc`. Defaults to ascending order when direction is omitted. The only supported sort field is `name`.
parameters.name: sort

200.description: The list of DNS Zones for the tenant.

errors.description: The sort expression is malformed or names an unsupported field.

400.description: Bad Request. The `sort` query parameter is malformed or names an unsupported field (`INVALID_FIELD`).

post.description:
Creates a new DNS Zone for the tenant from the supplied definition. Returns a reference to the newly created Zone, including its identifier and canonical URL. A tenant may hold at most a per-customer maximum number of DNS Zones (value TBD); a request that would exceed this per-customer cap is rejected with 400 `LIST_SIZE_EXCEEDED`.

**Required Permissions:** `ztna:create`

201.description: The DNS Zone was created. A reference to the new Zone is returned.

Location.description: Canonical URL of the newly created DNS Zone.

errors.description: The zone name must not be blank.

400.description: Bad Request. The request body failed bean or format validation — a missing required field or a malformed value (`INVALID_FIELD`), or an array field exceeds its maximum size such as more than 100 `domains` or 20 `nameServers`, or the per-customer zone cap (value TBD) would be exceeded (`LIST_SIZE_EXCEEDED`).

errors.description: A zone already serves an overlapping domain.

409.description: Conflict. A DNS Zone with the same name or overlapping domain already exists for the tenant.

errors.description: The referenced gateway is unknown or not owned by the tenant.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. The request is well formed but cannot be processed: the referenced gateway is unknown or not owned by the tenant (`GATEWAY_NOT_FOUND`), a name server IP falls outside the permitted range (`NAMESERVER_IP_OUT_OF_RANGE`) or is otherwise restricted (`NAMESERVER_IP_RESTRICTED`).

errors.description: The route-ownership service is temporarily unavailable. Retry the request.

503.description: Service Unavailable. A downstream dependency required to validate route ownership was unavailable. The request may be retried.

delete.description:
Deletes the DNS Zone identified by its UUID.

**Required Permissions:** `ztna:delete`

204.description: The DNS Zone was deleted. No content is returned.

get.description:
Returns a single DNS Zone identified by its UUID.

**Required Permissions:** `ztna:read`

parameters.description: Identifier of the DNS Zone to operate on.
parameters.name: id

patch.description:
Partially updates a DNS Zone using JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396). Any subset of the writable Zone fields may be supplied. A field set to a new value is overwritten; an omitted field is left unchanged; a field set to `null` clears it where the field is optional. Setting a required field to `null` is rejected (400, per ADG-302). No optimistic locking is in place for this release — consider ADG-148 (`VersionId` + `409 OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_FAILED`) in a follow-up if this becomes a concern.

**Required Permissions:** `ztna:update`

204.description: The DNS Zone was updated. No content is returned.

errors.description: A required field must not be set to null.

400.description: Bad Request. The merge patch failed validation — a field carries a malformed value, or a required field was explicitly set to `null` (per ADG-302) (`INVALID_FIELD`), or an array field exceeds its maximum size such as more than 100 `domains` or 20 `nameServers` (`LIST_SIZE_EXCEEDED`).

errors.description: A zone already serves an overlapping domain.

409.description: Conflict. The update would collide with an existing DNS Zone on name or an overlapping domain.

errors.description: A name server IP falls outside the permitted range.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. The request is well formed but cannot be processed: the referenced gateway is unknown or not owned by the tenant (`GATEWAY_NOT_FOUND`), a name server IP falls outside the permitted range (`NAMESERVER_IP_OUT_OF_RANGE`) or is otherwise restricted (`NAMESERVER_IP_RESTRICTED`).

errors.description: The route-ownership service is temporarily unavailable. Retry the request.

503.description: Service Unavailable. A downstream dependency required to validate route ownership was unavailable. The request may be retried.
